description: This file defines configuration options and related classes for the EventHub streaming provider in Orleans, including connection configuration, validation, and related settings.

classes.name: EventHubOptions
classes.description: Configuration settings for a specific Azure Event Hub, including connection setup and validation.

classes.name: EventHubOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the configuration of EventHubOptions to ensure proper setup.

classes.name: StreamCheckpointerConfigurationValidator
classes.description: Validates that a stream checkpointer is configured for a given streaming provider.

classes.name: EventHubReceiverOptions
classes.description: Options to configure the behavior of EventHub receivers, such as prefetch count and starting position.

classes.name: EventHubStreamCachePressureOptions
classes.description: Options controlling cache pressure and flow control for EventHub streaming.

methods.name: ConfigureEventHubConnection
methods.description: Various overloads to configure EventHub connection using connection string, fully qualified namespace with credentials, connection object, or delegate.

methods.name: ValidateValues
methods.description: Private helper to validate EventHub name and consumer group are non-empty.
